Deal a Skat game

Source: R/deal.R
sk_deal.Rd

Shuffles a full deck and deals ten cards to each of the three players plus a two-card skat, following the standard 3-4-3 deal pattern (the pattern does not affect play but is preserved for realism).

Usage

sk_deal(seed = NULL, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

seed

Optional whole-number seed for reproducible shuffles. If NULL (the default) the current random state is used. When a seed is supplied the previous random state is restored on exit, by any path.

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

An object of class sk_deal: a list with elements

  • hands: a length-3 list of sk_card vectors, ten cards each (players 1, 2, 3),

  • skat: an sk_card vector of length 2.

See also

sk_play_game() to play the deal out.

Examples

d <- sk_deal(seed = 1)
d$hands[[1]]
#> 10 Skat cards: ♣A ♣10 ♣J · ♠8 · ♥A ♥Q ♥J · ♦A ♦J ♦7
d$skat
#> 2 Skat cards: ♥9 · ♦Q
